title: 2nd special sitting of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamdu and Salawat) as the sitting begins.
Announcement of the day's agenda (agenda no. AJ/20/2026/KS/2).

Human Rights and Gender Committee report on the President's nominee for President of the Human Rights Commission of the Maldives, under section 8(b) of the Human Rights Commission Act (Law No. 6/2006).
Votes on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: A short special sitting during the recess to hear the committee report on the President's nominee to lead the Human Rights Commission, and to vote on it.
